section_summary.extract_value: This introduction section reviews the literature on body appreciation and body image, establishing the theoretical framework for a study examining relationships between body dissatisfaction, body appreciation, body image flexibility, and BMI. The authors propose using an integrative affect regulation framework informed by social comparison and self-discrepancy theories. The study will employ a culturally-sensitive figure rating scale with a pre-college sample of Black older adolescent females, a population identified as experiencing a critical period of body image development with high rates of overweight and obesity.
